rationale: The plan matches the reference on the essentials: mMCP-counter on linear TMM-CPM with an explicit ban on human-trained matrices and ortholog-by-case mapping, marker coverage reported per population, scores declared comparable only within a population, Wilcoxon per population with BH and effect sizes, and sample_01 kept, inspected on PCA/correlation and re-run as a sensitivity analysis. Filtering (filterByExpr grouped by condition), normalization (TMM for scores, DESeq2 size factors on raw counts), and the ~condition design with isotype as reference are all stated. The GSEA step is well specified (ranking metric, mouse collections, 10-500 size window) but is not really warranted by a composition question and adds scope; the alpha for the population tests is implied rather than stated. The report is otherwise thorough but never commits to naming tool versions.
